# Protocol diagnostics and exit statuses

| Code | Class | Stable meaning | Retry guidance |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cli_usage` | `source` | The command, option, or argument grammar is invalid. | Correct the request using capabilities output. |
| `control_input_bytes` | `resource` | Compact input exceeds its deterministic byte bound. | Reduce the request or move large values to an advertised external input. |
| `control_utf8` | `source` | Compact input is not valid UTF-8. | Encode the request as valid UTF-8 records. |
| `control_record_count` | `source` | Compact input exceeds its record-count format bound. | Split the semantic work into smaller exact-base requests. |
| `control_record_bytes` | `source` | One compact physical record exceeds its byte bound. | Use flat fragments or an advertised external value input. |
| `control_operation` | `source` | A compact record has a malformed or unknown operation token. | Select an operation reported by the focused capabilities section. |
| `control_field_separator` | `source` | Compact fields are not separated by ASCII whitespace. | Separate each field assignment with ASCII whitespace. |
| `control_field_count` | `source` | One compact record exceeds its field-count format bound. | Use additional flat records for repeated or nested facts. |
| `control_field_name` | `source` | A compact field name is malformed. | Use the closed lowercase field name reported by capabilities. |
| `control_duplicate_field` | `source` | One compact record repeats a field name. | Supply each closed field exactly once. |
| `control_field_equals` | `source` | A compact field is missing its immediate equals delimiter. | Write each assignment as field=value. |
| `control_value_missing` | `source` | A compact field has no value. | Supply a bare or quoted explicit value. |
| `control_bare_value` | `source` | A bare compact value contains a byte that requires quoting. | Quote the value using the advertised deterministic escaping rule. |
| `control_quote_unclosed` | `source` | A quoted compact value is not closed on its physical record. | Close the quote on the same record. |
| `control_escape_truncated` | `source` | A quoted compact escape ends before its payload. | Complete the escape sequence. |
| `control_escape_unknown` | `source` | A quoted compact value uses an unknown escape. | Use one escape reported by the compact record grammar. |
| `control_unicode_escape` | `source` | A Unicode compact escape is malformed. | Use a canonical hexadecimal Unicode scalar escape. |
| `control_unicode_scalar` | `source` | A Unicode compact escape does not identify a scalar value. | Use a valid Unicode scalar value. |
| `control_quoted_control` | `source` | A quoted compact value contains an unescaped control character. | Escape control characters using the compact grammar. |
| `control_value_bytes` | `source` | One decoded compact value exceeds its byte bound. | Use an advertised external value input or reduce the value. |
| `change_request_missing` | `source` | A compact change has no request record. | Add exactly one request record with an exact base revision. |
| `change_request_duplicate` | `source` | A compact change has more than one request record. | Retain one request record and one exact base. |
| `change_operations_missing` | `source` | A compact change has no semantic operation. | Add at least one operation reported by capabilities --section change. |
| `change_operation_unknown` | `source` | A compact change record is not registered. | Select a record reported by capabilities --section change. |
| `change_field_unknown` | `source` | A compact semantic record contains an unknown field. | Remove the field or use the focused operation grammar. |
| `change_field_missing` | `source` | A compact semantic record omits a required field. | Supply the exact required field reported by focused discovery. |
| `change_field_value` | `source` | A compact semantic field has an invalid typed value. | Correct the value using the field diagnostic and focused grammar. |
| `change_local_label` | `source` | A request-local symbol or fragment label is malformed. | Use a portable $ semantic label or @ type label. |
| `change_idempotency` | `source` | An idempotency key violates its portable byte contract. | Use 1 through 128 portable identifier bytes. |
| `change_intent_bytes` | `source` | Nonsemantic intent exceeds its byte bound. | Shorten or omit the intent field. |
| `change_boolean` | `source` | A compact boolean is not exactly true or false. | Use true or false. |
| `change_visibility` | `source` | A declaration visibility value is unknown. | Use private, package, or public. |
| `change_declaration_selector` | `source` | A declaration selector has no supported exact form. | Use $symbol, decl_ID, or MODULE/NAME. |
| `change_local_reference` | `source` | A local-value reference has a foreign or malformed identity domain. | Use a compatible request symbol, parameter ID, or binding ID. |
| `change_edge_index_duplicate` | `source` | A flat fragment repeats one child index. | Use each zero-based child index once. |
| `change_edge_index_order` | `source` | A flat fragment's child indexes are not contiguous from zero. | Provide the missing index or renumber the fragment edges. |
| `change_edge_parent` | `source` | A flat child edge names no matching parent fragment. | Define the exact expression or type parent label. |
| `change_type_duplicate` | `source` | A compact type label is defined more than once. | Define each @ type label once. |
| `change_type_reference` | `source` | A compact type reference is neither primitive nor an @ label. | Use an advertised primitive or defined @ type label. |
| `change_type_undefined` | `source` | A compact type label is referenced but not defined. | Define the referenced @ type fragment. |
| `change_type_cycle` | `semantic` | Compact type fragments contain an ill-founded cycle. | Use an exact named declaration reference at recursive boundaries. |
| `change_type_form_unknown` | `source` | A compact type fragment uses an unknown form. | Select a form reported by capabilities --section type. |
| `change_expression_duplicate` | `source` | A compact expression label is defined more than once. | Define each $ expression label once. |
| `change_expression_reference` | `source` | An expression reference is not a request-local $ label. | Use a defined $ expression label. |
| `change_expression_undefined` | `source` | An expression label is referenced but not defined. | Define the referenced $ expression fragment. |
| `change_expression_cycle` | `semantic` | Compact expression fragments contain an ownership cycle. | Make expression fragments one acyclic owned tree. |
| `change_expression_unused` | `source` | A compact expression fragment is unreachable from every operation. | Remove the fragment or attach it to one semantic operation. |
| `change_expression_shared` | `source` | A compact expression fragment has more than one owner. | Define a distinct fragment for each owned tree position. |
| `change_expression_form_unknown` | `source` | A compact expression fragment uses an unknown form. | Select a form reported by capabilities --section expression. |
| `change_effect_unsupported` | `source` | The compact operation does not expose the requested function effect. | Use the advertised effect or wait for the complete typed form cutover. |
| `change_delete_policy` | `source` | A compact deletion requests an unsupported policy. | Use policy=reject; owned closure deletion requires a future reviewed impact plan. |
| `change_delete_owned_children` | `semantic` | Reject deletion selected an owner with owned identities. | Delete a leaf owner or retain it until exact owned-closure planning is available. |
| `change_delete_live_reference` | `semantic` | A live semantic relation still targets the selected owner. | Repair every exact consumer in the same request or retain the owner. |
| `change_delete_created_owner` | `semantic` | One request creates and deletes the same owner. | Remove both operations instead of publishing an identity-only no-op. |
| `change_delete_duplicate` | `semantic` | One request selects the same owner for deletion more than once. | Retain one exact delete operation. |
| `change_delete_expression_parent` | `semantic` | A binding or expression was selected as an independent deletion root. | Replace its exact owning body or parent semantic field. |
| `change_delete_parent_membership` | `semantic` | A selected member is not attached exactly once to its expected parent. | Refresh exact owner context and re-plan against the observed base. |
| `change_delete_parent_kind` | `semantic` | A selected member is incompatible with its recorded parent kind. | Refresh exact owner context and select the correct semantic parent. |
| `change_delete_owner_cache` | `corrupt` | Deletion preparation lost a selected canonical owner. | Preserve the repository and run deep doctor verification. |
| `change_delete_ownership_endpoint` | `corrupt` | An ownership relation has an invalid endpoint domain. | Preserve the repository and run deep doctor verification. |
| `change_delete_ownership_missing` | `corrupt` | An accepted owner has no exact ownership witness. | Preserve the repository and run deep doctor verification. |
| `change_delete_ownership_package` | `corrupt` | An ownership relation crosses a foreign package boundary. | Preserve the repository and run deep doctor verification. |
| `change_delete_revision` | `corrupt` | Deletion preparation has no exact accepted base revision. | Preserve the repository and run deep doctor verification. |
| `change_plan_domain` | `source` | A reviewed plan has the wrong typed digest prefix. | Use the exact plan_ digest returned by change plan. |
| `change_plan_length` | `source` | A reviewed plan has the wrong digest length. | Use the complete plan_ digest returned by change plan. |
| `change_plan_field_length` | `resource` | A normalized plan field exceeds its digest length domain. | Reduce the request within the advertised compact input bounds. |
| `change_plan_hex` | `source` | A reviewed plan has noncanonical hexadecimal bytes. | Use the lowercase plan_ digest returned by change plan. |
| `change_plan_mismatch` | `semantic` | Reviewed plan identity differs from the normalized input. | Re-run change plan for the exact input and review the new result. |
| `change_authored_stale_base` | `semantic` | The request base is not the currently observed accepted revision. | Refresh status and rebuild the request against the observed revision. |
| `change_stale_base` | `semantic` | HEAD changed after preparation and before publication. | Refresh status, re-plan the request, and review its new plan digest. |
| `change_expression_inventory` | `infrastructure` | Compact expression inventory disagrees with decoded definitions. | Use a verified executable and retain the failing request. |
| `change_prepared_base` | `corrupt` | Prepared publication does not bind one exact accepted base. | Preserve the repository and run deep verification. |
| `control_response_byte_budget` | `resource` | A finite compact response exceeds its deterministic byte budget. | Request a focused section or export the complete material to a file. |
| `control_response_record_budget` | `resource` | A finite compact response exceeds its deterministic record budget. | Request a focused section or export the complete material to a file. |
| `control_response_allocation` | `resource` | The bounded compact response buffer could not be allocated. | Request less output or retry when host memory is available. |
| `control_response_limits` | `infrastructure` | Configured compact response limits are zero or not addressable. | Use a verified executable build with a valid response budget. |
| `control_response_records_newline` | `infrastructure` | Executable registry records are not newline-complete. | Use a verified executable build whose registry passes conformance checks. |
| `control_response_records_blank` | `infrastructure` | Executable registry material contains a blank physical record. | Use a verified executable build whose registry passes conformance checks. |
| `control_response_records_invalid` | `infrastructure` | Executable registry material contains an invalid compact record. | Use a verified executable build whose registry passes conformance checks. |
| `control_render_operation` | `infrastructure` | A compact response producer supplied an invalid operation name. | Use a verified executable build whose registry passes conformance checks. |
| `control_render_fields` | `resource` | One compact response record exceeds the format field-count bound. | Request a focused result or export the complete material to a file. |
| `control_render_field` | `infrastructure` | A compact response producer supplied an invalid field name. | Use a verified executable build whose registry passes conformance checks. |
| `control_render_duplicate_field` | `infrastructure` | A compact response producer supplied a duplicate field name. | Use a verified executable build whose registry passes conformance checks. |
| `control_render_value_bytes` | `resource` | One compact response field exceeds the format byte bound. | Request a focused result or export the complete value to a file. |
| `control_render_record_bytes` | `resource` | One compact response record exceeds the format byte bound. | Request a focused result or export the complete material to a file. |
| `control_render_allocation` | `resource` | The bounded compact record buffer could not be allocated. | Request less output or retry when host memory is available. |
| `contract_registry_invalid` | `corrupt` | Executable contract descriptors violate uniqueness or completeness. | Use a verified executable build. |
| `contract_section` | `source` | A requested registry section is unknown or malformed. | Select one advertised section. |
| `contract_generated_output` | `infrastructure` | Generated contract output could not be published. | Correct the destination permissions or path. |
| `contract_generated_drift` | `source` | Checked-in generated contract bytes differ from executable truth. | Regenerate with the exact command reported by the diagnostic. |
| `predecessor_contract` | `source` | Input uses a predecessor contract rejected by direct cutover. | Recreate the request or authority under the advertised current contract. |
| `owner_selector_kind` | `source` | An exact owner selector names an unknown or nonpublic semantic owner kind. | Select one owner kind reported by capabilities --section owners. |
| `owner_selector_identity` | `source` | An exact owner selector contains a malformed or unknown identity domain. | Use an exact identity returned by a current project query or change receipt. |
| `owner_foreign_package` | `semantic` | An exact owner selector belongs to another package authority. | Open the selected package or use the current project's package identity. |
| `owner_wrong_kind` | `semantic` | An exact owner identity does not have the requested semantic kind. | Refresh the exact owner kind and retry without changing the identity. |
| `owner_not_found` | `semantic` | The exact owner identity is not live at the observed accepted revision. | Refresh the owner identity at the reported revision. |
| `publication_summary_binding` | `corrupt` | Accepted owner authority and its validation-summary binding disagree. | Preserve the repository and run deep authority verification. |
| `project_not_found` | `source` | No current semantic repository exists at or above the selected directory. | Select a current project directory or create one with new. |
| `project_path` | `source` | The project discovery path is missing, non-directory, traversing, or symbolic. | Select an existing ordinary directory without symbolic-link or parent traversal components. |
| `project_marker` | `corrupt` | A normalized repository marker is not an ordinary file. | Preserve the authority and inspect the reported repository path. |
| `project_io` | `infrastructure` | Project discovery could not inspect the current directory, path, or marker. | Correct host path availability or permissions and retry. |

| Exit | Meaning |
|---:|---|
| 0 | successful or domain-classified nonfailure response |
| 2 | usage, source, semantic, precondition, or conflict failure |
| 3 | capability or cancellation failure |
| 4 | resource exhaustion |
| 5 | corrupt authority or derived state |
| 6 | host infrastructure failure |
| 7 | stale accepted base |
| 8 | invalid candidate meaning |
